summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026, under IAS 34. The document is a routine periodic report and does not disclose any special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or management change. The filing is purely financial reporting with no extraordinary transaction terms, board actions, or strategic announcements.
